## About this series

A millennium of macroeconomic data for the UK, Bank of England, v3.1 (Thomas and Dimsdale, 2017), sheet A21 (real GDP and population), rebased to pounds at 2016 prices with the GDP deflator. From 1700; England, then Great Britain and the UK. Early years are reconstructions. The file is no longer updated: last published in 2017, data to 2016.

## Indicator definition

Real GDP divided by population, so output per person. It measures living standards over time, not the size of the economy. For the population see Population of England and the UK, long run (Bank of England).

## How to read the data

Before the 18th century the values rest on thin evidence, so read trends over decades rather than single years. Sharp drops mark wars and financial crises, followed by recoveries.
